description: The bar-odd 5₂ Stokes datum O=½(S⁺−S⁻) (GGM Stokes matrix — the non-abelian analogue of resurgence) is MAJORITY non-abelian: off-diagonal carries 52.8% of ‖O‖² (> diagonal), and O is non-normal (no scalar diagonalization). This is the structural reason the scalar closed-form searches (φ_odd, 5₂ Habiro-tail, c₃ swing) fail — they are scalar projections of an irreducibly-matrix object. Correct carrier = the matrix, not a scalar phase.

data.verdict: THE BAR-ODD 5₂ STOKES DATUM IS MAJORITY NON-ABELIAN (scope-(a) structural). O = ½(S⁺−S⁻) (GGM Stokes matrix, the non-abelian analogue of the resurgent Borel datum): ‖O‖_F=2.10697, split ‖diag‖=1.4482 (abelian / formal-monodromy) vs ‖offdiag‖=1.53038 (non-abelian / Stokes). off/diag=1.0567; the off-diagonal carries 52.76% of ‖O‖² — MORE than the diagonal. O is non-normal (‖O−Oᵀ‖=1.7116≠0) so no scalar diagonalizes it; trace(O)=-0.0261 (the one clean scalar) captures almost none of it. CONCLUSION: the scalar closed-form searches (φ_odd σ1/σ2 arg-sum; 5₂ Habiro-tail 'no π²/5-analog'; c₃ swing carriers) fail STRUCTURALLY — they are scalar projections of an object 52.8% of which is off-diagonal and scalar-invisible. The correct bar-odd carrier is the MATRIX O (non-abelian invariants), not a scalar phase. Does NOT close c₃ (O is smooth, not the swing — SRigidityPrune binds); reframes where the datum lives. No fit; no c_k; no tier change.
